'''Longshoremen''' loaded cargo on and off [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Boat/Legends|vessels]] on [[Delassin VI|Delassin Six]]. [[Xenon Nnaksta]] was a longshoreman during the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].
